references.text: Describes the ambush that rose from its hiding place and entered the city, which is the event Joshua and Israel observe in verse 21.
The men of Ai saw smoke rising from the city, the same sign that Joshua and Israel used to know the ambush had succeeded.
Joshua's command to set fire to the city, which resulted in the smoke signal mentioned in verse 21.
Rahab's declaration that the Lord has given the land to Israel, now fulfilled through the conquest of Ai.
A similar pattern from the conquest of Jericho, where Israel struck down all the inhabitants of the city.
God's promise to give victory over enemies and strike them with confusion, which is fulfilled in the conquest of Ai.
The song of victory over Sihon and Heshbon, where smoke and fire are symbols of destruction, similar to the image at Ai.
